settings.scope: H2 and ideal steam source functions, exact-rational positiveCv certificate, printed-table arithmetic enclosures and source-consistentH/O/C reaction freeenergies only. No real-brick reaction rate or stable-liquid model.

source.gas_constant_policy: Historical book constant retained consistently with existingC/O phases. Not silently replaced by modernSI R.

visual_review.method: Rendered fullPDF pages and visually checked coefficients and298.15-1200K rows; no hash

source.reference_policy: h(T)=hf(298.15K)+integralCp. Formationenthalpy atT subtracts elemental sensible enthalpies, so is not single-species storage h(T).
source.rounding_policy: Printed coefficient/reference/table half-last-unit arithmetic enclosures only; no physical fit error or experimental covariance inferred.
source.phase_scope: Ideal gas standard-state functions. Below physical condensation temperatures the vapor standard state is a formal reference, not stable liquid-water equilibrium. No saturation/adsorption closure or energy alignment with low-temperature material inferred.

cv_certificate.method: z=sqrt(T), z^4 Cv is an eighth-degree polynomial. Exact rational runtime coefficients expanded in Bernstein form on each rational interval; divide its positive minimum coefficient by right^4. The cover contains the whole selected T domain.
